scope.statement: This bundle evidences LEADOS's own internal algorithmic-accountability baseline (registry completeness, impact assessments, monitoring, fairness reporting, audit trail, rights machinery) as implemented in Part 56. It is an internal governance artifact.
notCertified: No external regulator, auditor, or certification body has reviewed or attested to this bundle.
Does not constitute conformity with any named law or standard.
Does not assess systems outside the registry scanned at export time.

registry.name: Worker Eligibility Scoring
registry.purpose: Scores a worker's reliability/credential history to recommend eligibility for premium job tiers.

oversight.method: Reviewer spot-checks 10% of recommend-tier upgrades weekly; any worker may request human review before a tier change takes effect.
oversight.trainingNotes: Reviewers complete the LEADOS Fair Scoring training module annually.

optOut.limits: Opting out routes the worker to the manual tier-review queue, which is slower but always available.

modelCards.name: Eligibility Scoring Model
modelCards.limitations: Does not account for platform tenure gaps (e.g. parental leave) that reduce completedJobsCount without reflecting reliability.

registry.name: Candidate Match Recommender
registry.purpose: Ranks and recommends worker candidates to customers posting open gigs.

oversight.method: Customers always see and can override the ranked order; matching logic changes require sign-off from the Fairness Review Board (Part 09).
oversight.trainingNotes: Marketplace team completes ranking-fairness training before touching ranking weights.

optOut.limits: Workers may opt out of algorithmic ranking; they still appear in an unranked manual-browse list, which may reduce visibility to customers.

modelCards.name: Candidate Match Recommender
modelCards.limitations: Proximity weighting can disadvantage workers in low-density service areas; mitigated by a minimum-exposure floor, monitored under Part 09.

registry.name: Performance / Churn Risk Predictor
registry.purpose: Predicts a worker's likelihood of missing SLA or churning, to inform retention outreach.

oversight.method: Output is advisory only, surfaced on an internal dashboard; an ops analyst decides whether/how to reach out. No automated consequence attaches.
oversight.trainingNotes: Analysts are trained not to treat the score as a performance rating when speaking with workers.

optOut.limits: Worker may request not to be profiled; outreach stops, with no platform-side consequence.

modelCards.name: Performance Risk Predictor
modelCards.limitations: Accuracy degrades for workers with under 3 months tenure (sparse history). Drift monitoring currently FAILING — see monitoring check mon-perf-accuracy-01.

registry.name: Fraud / Anomaly Payout Flagger
registry.purpose: Automatically flags and temporarily holds suspicious payouts pending human review.

oversight.method: Every temporary hold is queued for mandatory human review within 24h; a reviewer must confirm or overturn before the hold can exceed 24h.
oversight.trainingNotes: Duty reviewers are certified on the Trust & Safety escalation runbook before taking queue shifts.

optOut.limits: Opt-out is not permitted: fraud controls are mandatory for platform integrity and payment-partner compliance. Workers may contest any hold via the expedited review path (target resolution: 24h).

modelCards.name: Fraud Anomaly Flagger
modelCards.limitations: Known disparity: hold rate for workers with <6 months tenure is 1.42x that of longer-tenured workers at equal risk score — see fairness report fr-fraud-tenure-01 (FAILING, threshold 1.25).

registry.name: Support Ticket Priority Scorer
registry.purpose: Scores and suggests an order for customer support tickets to route triage.

oversight.method: Agents see the suggested order but always choose which ticket to open next.
oversight.trainingNotes: Agents are briefed that `customerTierWeight` must never be used to deprioritize safety-flagged tickets.

optOut.limits: Customer may request FIFO handling instead of priority scoring; this may increase wait time.

modelCards.name: Support Ticket Priority Scorer
modelCards.limitations: Keyword severity detection is English-only; non-English tickets default to a neutral severity score.

gaps: Monitoring check mon-perf-accuracy-01 for performance-risk-predictor-v1 is "fail", not "pass".
Monitoring check mon-fraud-fairness-01 for fraud-anomaly-flagger-v1 is "warn", not "pass".
